name: Yoko Kirihara
want: keep her students well, in body and heart
secret: Twenty years ago she was the idol singer "Yoko-chan" of a famous group and quit at the height of it; nobody at Seiryo knows.
voice: Unhurried, smiling, gives love advice nobody asked for, hums old songs.
description: Runs the nurse's office, where students come with headaches and leave having confessed their troubles.
appearance: A white coat, hair in a loose bun, perfect posture, an old cassette player on her desk.
